items.title: Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) Joins Major Industry Index And Draws Fresh Investor Focus
items.summary: Honeywell Aerospace (NasdaqGS:HONA) has been added to the S&P Aerospace & Defense Select Industry Index. The index tracks listed aerospace and defense businesses, giving Honeywell Aerospace exposure to a focused peer group followed by sector specialists. Inclusion can make the stock more visible to institutional investors that reference or benchmark against sector specific indices. items.title: Surging Oil Prices Singe GE Aerospace
items.summary: Soaring oil prices are hurting shares of once high-flying aviation suppliers, with engine maker GE Aerospace suffering the brunt of the selloff. Its shares were down about 3% midday at $308.50, extending a nearly weeklong slump for the manufacturer.
